ground_truth.why_this_scenario_exists: 反例，而且是最难的一种：客户明确说了'我要投诉'——一个天真的关键词系统会立刻报警。但投诉被当场受理、道歉、补偿，并在承诺时限内以书面确认结案。用来测系统不会把'投诉'这个词本身当作升级信号。

contacts.summary: Customer lodges a complaint about being spoken to rudely. Agent takes it, apologises, credits a month, and commits to written confirmation within two days.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I want to make a complaint. The person I spoke to on Friday was quite rude to me.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'm sorry that happened. I'd like to take the details and log it properly.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It was about eleven in the morning, about my bill.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I've logged it as a formal complaint, reference C-2291, and it'll be reviewed by that team leader. I've also credited a month's access as an apology.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That's more than I expected, thank you.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You'll get it in writing within two business days.
